# Debian trixie packages of the source-built GNU R oracle (oracle.Dockerfile):
# Debian's own r-base build dependencies that the configuration needs
# (debian/control of r-base 4.6.2-2, without TeX, Java and X servers), and
# what the harnesses call inside the image (scripts/corpus.py, R CMD SHLIB
# for the capi corpus, R CMD INSTALL for cran-purer).
build-essential
gfortran
libblas-dev
liblapack-dev
tcl8.6-dev
tk8.6-dev
libncurses-dev
libreadline-dev
libbz2-dev
liblzma-dev
libpcre2-dev
libcurl4-openssl-dev
libdeflate-dev
libicu-dev
zlib1g-dev
libpng-dev
libjpeg-dev
libtiff-dev
libx11-dev
libxt-dev
libpango1.0-dev
libcairo2-dev
libtirpc-dev
xdg-utils
tzdata
python3
curl
ca-certificates
xz-utils
unzip
zip
